pool_license.note: The Stage 5D registry row says CC-BY-4.0; the AgriField-40K paper (arXiv:2608.07984, Table 1 and Section 3) says CC-BY-SA-4.0. The discrepancy is reported, not silently resolved. Either way it is a pool-level label for the compilation.

rule: A pool-level CC-BY label is a statement about the compilation, not proof that the pool maintainer could relicense third-party images. Creative Commons' guidance is that a licence only grants the rights the licensor is able to grant, and third-party material may need separate permission. That is the general principle used here; each upstream is graded on its own evidence, without extending it into a specific legal conclusion.
